Definition: Tsicha, the name of two Nethinim
BiblicalUsage: Ziha = "parched"; 1) ancestor of a family of temple slaves who returned from exile in Babylon with Zerubbabel; 2) a chief of the temple slaves in Ophel in the time of Nehemiah
